wiki_text: In April 2025 Gulf and PTT Tank announced they would move forward with Map Ta Phut LNG Terminal 3 (final investment decision), and on 24 June 2025 an extraordinary general meeting of Gulf MTP LNG Terminal Co Ltd (GMTP) approved a total investment not exceeding THB60 billion (~US$1.83 billion). On 1 July 2025 GMTP signed an EPCC (engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning) contract with the PEC-CAZ consortium — South Korea's POSCO E&C (POSCO Eco & Challenge, ~KRW1.5tn / ~US$1.1bn) and Thailand's CAZ — for the terminal superstructure on ~200 rai of reclaimed land. Land-reclamation works completed in March 2025. Superstructure construction was scheduled to begin in Q4 2025, with commercial operations targeted for Q1 2029.

Sources describe an initial LNG-import capacity of at least 5 million tonnes per annum (LNG Prime), expandable to a total of 10.8 mtpa; some outlets (Enerdata, Offshore Energy, Gulf) instead frame the initial regasification capacity as 8 Mt/year expandable to 10.8 Mt/year. GEM records the project as Phase I 5.0 mtpa + Phase II 5.8 mtpa = 10.8 mtpa total. The 10.8 mtpa full-build total is consistent across all sources; the initial-phase figure (5 vs 8 Mt/y) is reported inconsistently and the exact Phase I / Phase II split is not independently stated.
